analysis: 从保留019研究独立的分阶段attention，检验每querytile的混合核交接代价。当前三核窗口把WAIT_FLAG_DEVI分别映射到QK结果、PV输入与PV后输出，profiling每program Cube5.173333μs、Vector12.635757μs、Cube跨核等待31.411662μs；这些重叠量用于定位，完整关键路径仍需独立候选检验。候选保持完整S_kv softmax域、输入和输出dtype，仅把QK、向量softmax、PV分成独立Triton启动，将每tile跨核交接换为阶段间全局依赖。代价是额外全局中间张量、分配和launch，全部计入原full-call合同，真实收益保持开放。原先V独立转换011/012的经验保留：连续flat转换有效、逐元素gather会严重退步。此次可把连续V转换与softmax放在同一个纯Vector启动的互不重叠工作分区中，降低新增launch；禁止不同程序重叠写V。QK输出rawFP32分数，把原scale乘法放在softmax阶段，避免QK中增加向量epilogue；归一化FP16概率和FP16 V供PV，精度风险沿已验证021/022但重新用原四项checker检验。固定目标score约64MiB、归一化概率32MiB、V16约2MiB及输出16MiB；空间和流量均如实保存。此路线优先源码，单算子IR行打包和动态C/V编译选项保持独立实验。
requested_mechanism: One independent staged-attention mechanism from019, metadata-selected only for existingnoncausal BF16 D128 SKV256 shapes with compatiblecontiguousV and tiledS; allotherpaths retain originalalgorithm/FP16twoPV fallback. Aim three pureTriton launches: (1) rawQK BF16dot->FP32scores, no scale/vector epilogue; (2) FP32scale/max/exp2/sum, guarded rowreciprocal normalization toFP16P, plus disjoint contiguousflat BF16V->FP16 scratch conversion in the same Vectorlaunch; (3) FP16P*FP16V dot with FP32accumulation and direct outputdtypecast/store. Keep full256keydomain and M128 matrix tiles; choose safeVector rowtile e.g64 and verify actualUB. Use uniqueownership for Vflat chunks, no redundant/racing writes. Allscratches/output fresh eachcall, no outputcache, externalcompute, changedchecker or hidden workoutside timing. Originalpublicrun returns contiguousBSND shape/dtype like019, originalfour fullcall includes allallocations and allstages. For observation keep selectedfinalPV JIT name _gqa_fwd_kernel; originalfallback may be renamed without changing its body. Model must explicitly record numerical differences (normalizedFP16weights vs original postPVdivision), additionalmemory/launchcost and predictedremoval of per-tile mixedcorehandoffs, then implement/preflight/handoff.
